notes.title: The Music Of Super Agent: Drunk Kent
notes.content:
Music plays a heavy role in Super Agent: Drunk Kent, It sets a scene, motivates the player, and helps bring worlds and environments to life! ALL the music featured in Super Agent: Drunk Kent is of my own creation, something im very proud of. I just wanted my game to have a kick-ass soundtrack. 

Heres some tracks i've completed so far:
